content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Ester Industries Limited (NSE: ESTER) Ester Industries Reports Q2FY27 Consolidated Revenue at ₹449.0 Crore and PAT at ₹7.8 Crore ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Consolidated Revenue: ₹449.0 Cr (up 25.7% YoY) - Consolidated EBITDA: ₹45.1 Cr (up 160.0% YoY) - Consolidated PAT: ₹7.8 Cr (vs loss of ₹15.8 Cr YoY) - Standalone Revenue: ₹365.8 Cr (up 38.9% YoY) - Standalone PAT: ₹6.1 Cr (vs loss of ₹4.8 Cr YoY) 📌 What happened: ↳ Ester Industries announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, registering significant growth in consolidated revenue and turning net profitable compared to losses in the corresponding quarter last year. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
